== Revised Dagobah white-border face ==
The published white-border image [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/dark/images/bosskwb.gif bosskwb.gif], Decipher’s Dagobah card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010903120630id_/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/dark/images/bosskwb.gif Internet Archive], captured 3 September 2001. supports this printing’s image and game text.
The extra attrition explanation is the separate paragraph following Bossk’s card text on page 29 of the November 1998 Glossary. It is retained under Rulings with that source.
Existing page names, identifiers and family navigation are preserved.
